title: Change or migration plan with rollback criteria
description: Plans a controlled change with validation gates, ownership, communications, and explicit rollback triggers.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: change-migration-rollback-plan
  title: Change or migration plan with rollback criteria
  description: Plans a controlled change with validation gates, ownership, communications, and explicit rollback triggers.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Execute changes safely and restore service quickly if success criteria are not met.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - change-authority
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Change scope and constraints
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - change
          - systems
          - successCriteria
          - constraints
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: plan
      kind: agent
      name: Build implementation plan
      role: Change manager
      prompt: Define phases, owners, dependencies, communications, testing, monitoring, and approvals.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - operations-planning
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: rollback
      kind: agent
      name: Define rollback plan
      role: Reliability engineer
      prompt: Define measurable rollback triggers, decision authority, restoration steps, data safeguards, and rollback
        validation.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - release-engineering
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: readiness
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Readiness gate
      role: Change reviewer
      prompt: Return passed only when implementation, validation, communication, and rollback requirements are complete.
      config:
        threshold: 1
    - id: change-authority
      kind: approval
      name: Change authority approves execution
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Approved migration plan and rollback runbook
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: plan
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: rollback
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: plan
      to: readiness
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: rollback
      to: readiness
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: readiness
      to: change-authority
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e6
      from: change-authority
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
